name_story.story: Syahmi can be understood through the Arabic form شَهْمِي, whose central sense is syahmi; of noble character (malay form). Syahmi is the Malay form of Arabic شَهْمِيّ (Shahmī), the relative form of شَهَامَة (nobility), used as a male given name.

faq.a: Syahmi is associated with the Arabic form شَهْمِي, whose core sense is syahmi; of noble character (malay form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Syahmi?
faq.a: Syahmi is associated with Arabic. Syahmi is the Malay form of Arabic شَهْمِيّ (Shahmī), the relative form of شَهَامَة (nobility), used as a male given name.
Yes — the underlying form شَهْمِي is Arabic.
Syahmi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Syahmi should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Shahmī is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Syahmi mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Syahmi is rendered شہمی and carries the sense شہمی، بہادر.

faq.q: What does Syahmi mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Syahmi is rendered شهمی and carries the sense شهمی، شجاع.
A romanized syllable approximation is syah-mi. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Syahmi?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Syahmi, syahmi. Script forms are شهمي, شهمی, شَهْمِي, شہمی, शहमी.

faq.q: Is Syahmi a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
